summary: OPENALEX_API_KEY, when set, is sent to OpenAlex as an Authorization: Bearer header (never in the URL), only when the request goes to https://api.openalex.org (exact host; custom base URLs and plain http never receive the env key), and a same-host redirect that fails that gate (https to http downgrade) has the inherited Authorization header removed only when it equals the env-derived credential (an explicit [headers] or per-call Authorization is never touched), and flows through the existing masking and cache-key plumbing; a regen must keep reading that variable and must not send an empty credential when it is unset.
reason: OpenAlex meters the API per key (no key = 1,000 list calls/day, free key = 10,000) and the former OPENALEX_MAILTO polite pool no longer exists, so a keyless CLI exhausts its daily budget quickly.
validated_outcome: Against api.openalex.org the Bearer header yields the keyed limit (X-RateLimit-Limit 10000) exactly like the api_key query parameter, versus 1000 without a key.
